issues.title: App crashes on login with special characters
issues.description: When users enter special characters like @, #, $ in the password field, the app crashes with an unhandled exception. Reproducible on both iOS and Android.

issues.title: Dashboard charts not loading on slow networks
issues.description: Under 3G conditions, the dashboard pie chart remains in a loading state indefinitely. Timeout handling is missing.

issues.title: Profile image upload fails silently
issues.description: Uploading a profile image larger than 5MB fails without showing any error message to the user. Expected: show a clear error or compress the image.

issues.title: Dark mode colors incorrect in settings screen
issues.description: Several text labels in the Settings screen remain black even when dark mode is active, making them unreadable.

issues.title: Pagination broken on issue list — page 3 skips to page 5
issues.description: When navigating through the issue list, tapping Next on page 3 incorrectly loads page 5. Regression introduced in v1.2.0.

issues.title: Search results not updating in real-time
issues.description: The search bar on the issue list screen only updates results on form submit, not on each keystroke as designed.

issues.title: Session expires but no redirect to login
issues.description: After the JWT token expires, API calls return 401 but the user is not redirected to the login screen. They see raw error messages instead.

issues.title: Notification badge count incorrect after read
issues.description: After marking notifications as read, the badge count on the home tab does not decrement. Requires app restart to clear.

issues.title: Export to CSV missing timezone offset in dates
issues.description: Exported CSV files show dates without timezone information, causing confusion for international teams. Should include UTC offset.

issues.title: Pull-to-refresh crashes on empty list
issues.description: When the issue list is empty and the user pulls to refresh, the app throws a RangeError. Needs guard for empty state before refresh logic.
